thread:
Maya K: quick sync — vendors reported a partial H100 shipment delay (vendor A pushed 3 racks ~5 days), vendor B still on track. Can we confirm impact on the canary cluster schedule? Asking owners: @alex_r on rack bringup, @tom_h on provisioning, @elena_s on reservation swaps.

Alex R: saw the email. We can shift one canary pod to the remaining spare racks in us-west for the next 48h. Need infra runbook update. I'll take bringup today EOD. :thumbsup: 

Tom H: provisioning team blocked on NIC firmware 2.1.4 — vendor sent validated image but we need QA signoff for the firmware bundle. Pinged QA.

Elena S: reservation team — we have ~10% buffer in Dedicated reservations for May, but EMEA quota is tight. If we move the canary to us-west, we should be fine. I'm OK to apply a temporary override and own the permission changes.

Srinivas: QA here — can do firmware smoke tests by tomorrow morning, but need access to the test VLAN (vlan-qa-3). If Alex can add the nodes to /api/devices, I'll run the script below:

```
./infra/tests/smoke_firmware.sh --nodes h100-0[1-4] --image 2.1.4
```

Maya K: Alex — can you confirm adding nodes? Also, any ETA on terraform PR for the reservation swap? PR #482 still needs review.

Alex R: adding nodes now. Also pinging @Elena S about the terraform change — I'll drop a comment on PR #482 with the plan to temporary override and the rollback steps. Should be ready for review in ~2h.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: vlan changes for vlan-qa-3 at 2025-06-14T02:00Z (automated window). Approver required: elena.s@redwood.com

Elena S: approved. I'll sign the change for the override. Note: we should notify customers on the dedicated-capacity status page if we expect any SLA jitter during the swap window.

Tom H: QA confirmed NIC smoke passed on 3/4 nodes, failing on h100-03 due to bad cable. Facilities to replace the cable tomorrow morning. After replacement, I'll rerun provisioning.

Maya K: Action items: Alex — add nodes + PR comment; Tom — cable replacement + rerun; Srinivas — smoke run after nodes are added; Elena — apply override and notify customers if needed. I'll consolidate and send a 1-pager to eng-ops later today. :raised_hands: 

deploy-bot: notification sent to #dedicated-capacity-status: "Canary delay mitigated by temporary us-west placement; followups scheduled."

Maya K: thanks all — if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. I'll update the buildout timeline doc with the adjusted canary date and link PR #482 once Alex comments.
